kind.description: thread: an isolated thread's preparation record (its worktree, registration and branch); envelope: an isolated envelope base; staging: an object-store staging directory.

outcome.description: released/completed: its release ran (completed: a finished checkout kept as made); cleanup_failed: it ran and a step failed, any saved basis stays for retry; refused: nothing was released; stale: inspect again; not_held: nothing held there (not a proof of an earlier release); basis_not_recorded: the confirmation could not be saved, nothing was released.

operation_id.description: The durable delivery command (`delivery.preparation_release`) recorded before any effect, holding this receipt; a repeat with the same Idempotency-Key answers from it.

replayed.description: This is the recorded receipt of an earlier request with the same key.

generation.description: The record's generation the request acted on (null when none was read).

stop.description: The stop the record named (history, not a measurement); null after a crash.

confirmed_at.description: The operator confirmation the record carried after this request (new or continued); null when none was needed or recorded.

anyOf.description: machine_proven: a read proved that what the preparation started has ended; operator_confirmed: the operator's recorded confirmation released it (not a proof); saved_cleanup: this generation's ordinary cleanup or handover basis permitted release after fresh checks, without a new confirmation or machine proof.

basis.description: machine_proven: a read proved that what the preparation started has ended; operator_confirmed: the operator's recorded confirmation released it (not a proof); saved_cleanup: this generation's ordinary cleanup or handover basis permitted release after fresh checks, without a new confirmation or machine proof.

continued.description: An earlier confirmation of the same record was continued.

outcome.description: One read of the recorded writer's pid (no birth was recorded for it): plausible_original refuses; born_after_hold and missing take that pid off as an authority; unknown proves nothing.
